name: Jaguar Temple
review:
An Incan temple on 20 lines, with expanding symbols in the base game and expanding wilds in the bonus. It has a book-style rhythm, where one good expansion can fill the screen.

Medium volatility, 2,045x cap, 96.1% RTP. Calmer than most of Thunderkick's catalogue, so it's a good fit if you want features without the huge swings.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
